remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY FRIDAY 4/18 @ 2PM Welcome to Old Greenwich Gables! This stunning corner unit has undergone a total renovation, resulting in a sunny and bright living space that is sure to impress. Prepare to be amazed by the completely redesigned chef's kitchen. It offers a breakfast room where you can start your day with a cup of coffee, and plenty of cabinets to store all your culinary essentials. This kitchen is truly a chef's delight! The open living and dining room is perfect for entertaining or enjoying quality time with your loved ones. From here, step out onto your private deck and take in the serene view of the fountain. It's the ideal spot to unwind and relax. The main level also boasts a large primary bedroom, featuring beautiful wood flooring and a luxurious en-suite bathroom.Upstairs, you'll find a second bedroom with multiple closets and its own full bathroom, providing privacy and convenience for family members or guests. Every detail has been carefully considered to provide the utmost comfort and style.  The clubhouse is the perfect place to socialize and host events. Take a dip in the heated outdoor pool, play a game of squash or workout in the exercise room. The location couldn't be more convenient. You'll have quick and easy access to the train village, nearby parks, Todd's Point beach & park and a variety of shopping options.
